verdict.rationale: Otter offers search across all past meetings and AI Chat that can answer questions using meeting history (otter-docs-1, otter-docs-11, otter-docs-18), plus organization of meetings by client/topic (otter-docs-12, otter-docs-5) which could let a founder manually pull up prior context. But there's no evidence of a proactive, calendar-triggered feature that automatically surfaces past meetings with the same attendees and a pre-call brief of open threads before a meeting starts — the capability shown is reactive search, not automated prep. Missing for 10: calendar-integration trigger for automatic pre-meeting briefs, attendee-matching logic to surface 'same people' history, and any evidence of this working hands-on.
